subject: Next steps & availability — MediQuant evaluation kickoff and success criteria
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha@mediquant.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 17:12:00 +0000
Subject: Post-discovery — proposed next steps and kickoff availability

Hi Aisha (and team),

Thanks again for the time today — good call and clear product fit for the use cases you outlined (clinical summarization + clinician QA assist). Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can lock the evaluation plan: 

- Goal: Run a 3-week evaluation to validate throughput & accuracy on your anonymized clinic transcripts and measure clinician acceptance against your current process.
- Success criteria (draft): 1) ≥85% precision on medication extraction in our prompt evals; 2) average end-to-end latency ≤450ms on 512-token requests during peak; 3) clinician acceptability >75 in small user panel.
- Technical/people needed from MediQuant: one infra contact for test environment access, one clinician SME for prompt set review, and a security/compliance contact (you mentioned Raj).

Action items I propose:
1) Schedule a 60-minute evaluation kickoff where we can: confirm success criteria, review trial data ingestion steps, and hand off the prompt pack.
2) After kickoff, schedule a 90-minute technical deep-dive for your infra team to validate network/keys and to test sample payloads.

Proposed kickoff windows (your timezone):
- Tue 25 May, 10:00–11:00 AM ET
- Wed 26 May, 2:00–3:00 PM ET
- Thu 27 May, 9:00–10:00 AM ET

I attached a one-pager with rollout/questions and a draft kickoff agenda for review (proposed-kickoff-agenda.docx). Also linking our prompt template here: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/prompt-template (we'll adapt to your sample transcripts).

Can you share which of these slots work and who from your side will join? If none of the above fit, happy to propose more.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0191
Redwood Inference

Per your asks:
- Quick access checklist (high level):
  • One sample folder of ~200 anonymized transcripts (SFTP preferred)
  • Point-of-contact for SFTP + expected file naming convention
  • Test account for API keys or temporary token + IP allowlist (if using direct API)
  • List of example clinician prompts/workflows you want validated
- Security pack: linking our Security & Compliance page (SOC2 report and cert): https://redwood.ai/security/soc2 (internal: share via secure link). If procurement needs a copy, Marissa will own the handoff.

Roles for the kickoff:
- Marissa Cole will lead success criteria and prompt-pack alignment (marissa@redwood.ai)
- Ben Carter will own the technical runbook and demo of token/latency tradeoffs (ben@redwood.ai)

Calendar invite (pending) will include a short agenda and the meeting link. Also attaching the prompt template again; please ask Dr. Morales to flag 8–10 representative prompts for the pack.

Vivek
